How you'll make an impact

As a member of our Financial Institutions business unit, you will serve as a trusted advisor to bank executives and boards of directors, helping clients navigate complex balance sheet, asset/liability management (ALM), interest rate risk, liquidity, and strategic planning decisions.

You will work closely with CEOs, CFOs, treasury leaders, risk officers, executive management teams, and boards of directors to translate complex financial and balance sheet dynamics into meaningful business insights and actionable strategies. Through thoughtful analysis, effective communication, and deep banking expertise, you will help clients better understand risks, opportunities, and potential outcomes while supporting critical strategic decisions.

Success in this role requires a unique combination of technical expertise, strategic thinking, executive presence, and relationship management. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable analyzing model assumptions and presenting insights in a boardroom, helping decision-makers understand not only what the numbers indicate, but also what actions may be appropriate in response.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead client discussions that connect financial performance, risk exposures, and strategic objectives.

jobs.location_raw: Addison, TX (Hybrid); Bellevue, WA (Hybrid); Durham, NC (Hybrid); Emeryville, CA (Hybrid); Reston, VA (Hybrid)
jobs.description_text:
Senior Sales Operations Manager

 

The Basics:

The Senior Manager of Sales Operations is the operational right hand to Tanium's velocity leader and the sales operations partner for the U.S. mid-market and commercial sales teams. This leader builds and runs the operating engine for down market and product-led motions: the funnel from first visit to trial to paid to revenue, lead routing, forecasting, segmentation and coverage, compensation mechanics, and the data and systems that tie them together. 

The Senior Manager translates the down market leader's strategy into sales operations that work in practice, and keeps core sales operations running for the mid-market and commercial teams. This leader understands how buyers try, buy, and expand in product-led and high-volume motions, and brings that view to forecasting, pipeline inspection, and process design. The role partners closely with Marketing, Sales Development, Product, Finance, Partners, and the broader Sales Operations team, and builds a team as the motion scales. 

This position follows the Company’s hybrid schedule which currently requires employees to work in the office at one of the following locations a minimum of three days per week: Addison, TX; Bellevue, WA; Durham, NC; Emeryville, CA; or Reston, VA.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Senior Director, Program Management to serve as the operating backbone of the global Marketing organization. Reporting directly to the CMO, you will build and steward the operating model through which marketing programs and go-to-market efforts are planned, resourced, funded, sequenced, and delivered — across every marketing function and every international market we operate in.

About Virtru:

While the rest of the security industry obsesses over locking data down to prevent it from being lost or stolen, we're doing something fundamentally different at Virtru. We're setting data free so that you can intentionally share it with others, but without sacrificing security, privacy, or control.

We've created both a suite of powerful data protection applications and an open platform that's sparking an ecosystem of innovation. Through the Trusted Data Format (TDF) open standard, we're not just protecting data; we're creating a new paradigm where security enables sharing rather than preventing it.

Think of us as the Android of data protection: a robust platform with an open core that developers and partners can build upon, coupled with our own best-in-class applications that showcase what's possible when you reimagine security from the ground up.

Backed by Iconiq Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, Foundry Capital, and Tiger Global, we're helping Fortune 500 companies and government agencies discover that true data security means having the freedom to share, collaborate, and innovate — without compromise.

Job Description:

The pipeline controller position is in Brookshire, Texas.   • Remote starting/ stopping pumps/compressors and operating valves.
  • Monitoring and controlling the movement of product through multiple lines and facilities.
  • Monitoring of storage field activity
  • Analyzing changing conditions and alarms, making necessary adjustments
  • Determining accurate time of pipeline events (deliveries, noms, batches, etc.)
  • Ability to quickly detect abnormal operations and use critical judgement to react accordingly.
  • Monitor pipeline integrity and coordinate with field personnel all maintenance activities.
  • Communicating with field personnel, scheduling groups, customers and suppliers to maximize efficiency, safety, quality and customer service.
